proof_summary: For every exponent residue modulo 48, one of \(3,5,7,17,97,257,673\) divides \(5292270077783\cdot 2^m+1\), so \(5292270077783\) is a Sierpiński number. At \(n=473165\), the endpoints are \(5292270077779\) and \(5292270077807\), and this Sierpiński number lies strictly between them, disproving consecutiveness.
